hypothesis: Lipid nanoparticle delivery of modified nucleoside-containing mRNA reduces immunogenicity while maintaining stability for vaccine development
prediction: The immunogenicity of modified nucleoside-containing mRNA delivered by lipid nanoparticles will be 70% lower than unmodified mRNA delivered by the same method
measurement_method: Compare immune response markers (e.g., cytokine levels, antibody production) between groups receiving modified vs unmodified mRNA via lipid nanoparticles
falsification_condition: If the modified mRNA shows less than 15% reduction or any increase in immunogenicity compared to unmodified mRNA
